text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's sold out here too...
This is the fifth
bookstore
already!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Every time a new volume comes out, the
series
just gets more and more popular...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what should I do? It's almost time
for
training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's 2.2 kilometers to the bookstore at
the next
station over... If I use the Uma
lane, it should only
take two minutes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I really hope they have it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Mejiro Dober fails to find the
manga
she wants and continues her
search instead of
coming to practice.
